title: StockSmart Replenishment Service Standard — Delivery, Pricing, Invoicing and Freight
content:
This standard governs how bins under the StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program are replenished and billed.

### 1. When replenishment is delivered

1.1 Replenishment is delivered only on a program whose status is active or terminating.

1.2 Replenishment is delivered only while the customer's Commercial Credit Account status is active or on hold, and while it is on hold only on a tier whose credit hold service rule is critical items only, only for bins flagged critical; on a tier whose rule is suspend the program is paused with the pause reason credit hold until the hold is released.

1.3 *Retired wording.* The words of clause 1.2 that read "and only up to the tier's critical item replenishment cap per visit (bins are filled in bin label order until the next bin would exceed the cap)" are **no longer in force**; they are superseded by the current basis for replenishment during a credit hold.

| Credit account status | Tier's credit hold service rule | Replenishment under clause 1.2 |
|---|---|---|
| active | any | delivered |
| on hold | critical items only | delivered for bins flagged critical only |
| on hold | suspend | none; the program is paused with the pause reason credit hold until the hold is released |
| any other status | any | none |

### 2. Fill level and price

2.1 *Retired wording.* The sentence "Every bin at or below its min level at a visit or self-scan is filled to its max level under the tier's fill-to rule" is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current basis.

2.2 Each item is billed at the price the Contract Pricing Agreement's price basis gives for the delivery date, under the tier's replenishment pricing basis.

### 3. Invoicing and freight

3.1 The replenishment of one visit or self-scan order is billed on one invoice under the tier's invoice grouping. Where the tier's freight basis is the ship-to freight terms, the scan order is treated as an order of the served ship-to for standard freight under the Ship-To Fulfillment Account's freight and fee rules, and where freight is included no freight is billed.

### 4. Service

4.1 Bins are counted under the tier's scan method; the Onsite Storeroom is staffed the tier's onsite hours a week; an emergency visit is made within the tier's emergency response hours of the request.

4.2 Scheduled visits follow the tier's service visits per month; deliveries reach the bins within the tier's replenishment lead business days of the scan or visit.

### Points of judgement

- The status tests in 1.1 and 1.2 are read from Corbett's records: the program's status, and the status of the customer's Commercial Credit Account.
- On a hold, the critical flag is read from the bin's own entries.
